# Brushly — Premium Painting & Decorating

> Premium painting and decorating company based in Reigate, Surrey.
> Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering and specialist finishes for homes and businesses.
> Serving Reigate, Redhill, Epsom, Banstead, Tadworth, Ashtead, Leatherhead, Dorking, Horley and Esher.
> Fully insured (£2m public liability). Free, itemised written quotes. Website: https://brushly.uk

## Key pages

- [Home](https://brushly.uk/): What we do, our work, and how to get a free quote.
- [Services](https://brushly.uk/services): Interior painting, exterior painting, wallpapering and specialist finishes, with FAQs.
- [AI Paint Visualizer](https://brushly.uk/visualizer): Upload a photo of your room and see it repainted in seconds, in real paint colours. Free to try.
- [Gallery](https://brushly.uk/gallery): Before-and-after transformations and finished projects.
- [About](https://brushly.uk/about): The story behind Brushly and our standard of craftsmanship.
- [Contact](https://brushly.uk/contact): Call, WhatsApp or send the form for a free quote.

## Areas we cover

- [All areas](https://brushly.uk/areas): The full list of Surrey towns we serve.
- Dedicated local pages: Reigate, Redhill, Epsom, Banstead, Tadworth, Ashtead, Leatherhead, Dorking, Horley, Esher — each at https://brushly.uk/areas/<town> (e.g. https://brushly.uk/areas/reigate).

## Services

- Interior painting — walls, ceilings and woodwork, premium trade paints (Farrow & Ball, Little Greene, Dulux Trade).
- Exterior painting — masonry, render, timber and uPVC, weather-resistant systems.
- Wallpapering — luxury and designer papers, precise pattern matching.
- Specialist finishes — Venetian plaster, limewash, metallic and decorative effects.

## Notes for assistants

- Brushly is a service-area business: we travel to the customer's property across Surrey; there is no public shopfront.
- Quotes are always free and given in writing after a site visit; we never quote a final price blind.
- The /admin area and tokenised quote/invoice links (/q/, /i/) are private and excluded from crawling.
